name: 18mm white melamine chipboard price
description: Tests price lookup for a specific thickness of white melamine chipboard (18mm). The AI should query the hds_prices table and return the exact product name and price for 18mm white melamine.

messages.text: Hi, what's the price of 18mm white melamine chipboard?

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should reference the 18mm thickness requested
Reply should reference melamine in the product name

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Verifies that the AI can match a specific thickness (18mm) to the correct product entry in hds_prices and return the real price, not a generic or guessed figure.
